node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one constant-color exclusion
node.statement: On every official m=8,h=7 order-one row, the six roots left after removing the automatic root cannot all have the same p+1 Frobenius color. The first two colored reciprocal coefficient equations force rho*c=1-alpha and then 30alpha(c-1)=(alpha+1)zeta+12alpha^2. Its F_(p^2)/F_p norm equation has no solution at any eighth-root trace in an official characteristic.
node.notes: Complete exclusion of the constant-color stratum only. The live h=7 residue has a non-base-field conic parameter and a nonconstant assignment-preserving color interpolant; higher color degrees and all inner conditions remain open.
